Wystawia jeden endpoint (zgodny z API Op: Exposes a single endpoint (OpenAI-compatible) behind which LiteLLM routes requests to models on the hosts from the server list (the bar at the top of the window). This means e.g. VS Code/Continue can use models on several computers at once while pointing at just this one address.
Podgląd modeli i hostów, które trafią do: Preview of the models and hosts that will end up in the LiteLLM config, based on the server list at the top of the window.
Jak długo model zostaje w pamięci po ost: How long a model stays in memory after the last request before being unloaded (a few minutes by default). E.g. 30m, 1h, -1 (always), 0 (immediately).
Rozmiar okna kontekstu w tokenach (domyś: Context window size in tokens (the default 4096 is too small for agentic work in Continue/OpenCode).
Ile modeli może być jednocześnie załadow: How many models can be loaded into memory at the same time (default: 3x the number of GPUs).
Ile równoległych zapytań obsłuży jeden z: How many parallel requests a single loaded model will handle at once.
Zmniejsza zużycie pamięci przy dłuższym: Reduces memory usage with a longer context, if the model and hardware support it.
Kwantyzacja pamięci podręcznej kontekstu: Context cache quantization - q8_0 is roughly -50% VRAM usage with negligible quality loss.
Backend Vulkan zamiast ROCm - szersza ko: Vulkan backend instead of ROCm - broader compatibility with AMD cards without full ROCm support (e.g. BC-250).

Wklej poniższą treść do pliku ~/.continu: Paste the text below into ~/.continue/config.yaml (overwriting it entirely, or merging it by hand with what's already there if you have other models). The app never writes this file automatically.
Brak dostępnych modeli (hosty nieosiągal: No models available (hosts unreachable or empty) - check the server list at the top of the window and try again.
Każdy model dostaje domyślnie role: chat: Every model gets the default roles: chat, edit, apply. Other roles are also available for manual editing in the text below: autocomplete (editor suggestions), embed (embedding models, e.g. nomic-embed-text - used for RAG), rerank (search result ranking). A model that isn't meant for chat/code editing should have its roles swapped for the right one from this list.
Czy Ollama może korzystać ze zintegrowan: Whether Ollama can use the integrated GPU (iGPU) - enabled by default. Turn it off (in the Advanced tab) to force skipping the iGPU (e.g. for problems on a unified CPU+GPU architecture like the BC-250).
Domyślnie Ollama nasłuchuje tylko lokaln: By default Ollama only listens locally (127.0.0.1) - other devices on the network can't connect. Turn it on (in the Advanced tab) to make it listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) and be reachable from outside this computer (e.g. from another PC, or for a BC-250 acting as a client).
Linia {numer} (\"{linia}\") nie ma posta: Line {numer} ("{linia}") isn't in KEY=VALUE form - fix it before saving.
Opis każdej zmiennej: zakładka \"Pomoc\": See each variable's description in the "Help" tab. "Save" applies ALL fields at once and restarts the Ollama service (requires administrator privileges - currently loaded models will briefly disappear from memory). An empty field = Ollama's default behavior.
Wypełniono formularz zalecanymi wartości: Form filled with the recommended values - review them and click "Save" to apply.
Zapisać wszystkie pola z tej zakładki i: Save all fields on this tab and restart the Ollama service?
Sprawdź dostępne modele (i warianty kwan: Check available models (and quantization variants) at ollama.com/library, type the name in the field above and click Pull.
Szacowane zużycie pamięci: podaj rozmiar: Estimated memory usage: enter the model size (e.g. 8b) to see the estimate.
Który indeks urządzenia Vulkan ma być wi: Which Vulkan device index should be visible to the backend (0 = first) - necessary on some APUs (e.g. BC-250), where Vulkan enumerates several devices at once and without this Ollama might pick the wrong one. Only has an effect together with OLLAMA_VULKAN enabled.

Na APU / pamięci współdzielonej zarezerw: On an APU / shared memory, reserve RAM for the system via OLLAMA_GPU_OVERHEAD.
Ile pamięci GPU (w bajtach) zarezerwować: How much GPU memory (in bytes) to keep away from Ollama, for the rest of the system - relevant on APUs with memory shared with system RAM. A server without a desktop environment usually needs no reservation; a workstation with a desktop (KDE/GNOME) shares the same VRAM pool with the compositor, so without a reservation Ollama could take all of it.
